title: Mannesmann Energy signs EPC agreement with ADNOC Onshore for NEB Facilities Upgrade Project – Phase II
summary: Agreement signed at ADIPEC 2026 covers brownfield upgrades at Al Nouf and Rumaitha/Shanayel facilities, reinforcing Mannesmann Energy’s role in supporting the development of the UAE’s energy infrastructure

contentHtml:
Mannesmann Energy, an Abu Dhabi-based Emirati engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contractor and technology integrator, has signed an agreement with ADNOC Onshore to execute Phase II of the North East Bab (NEB) Facilities Upgrade Project. Image courtesy: Mannesmann Energy

Agreement signed at ADIPEC 2026 covers brownfield upgrades at Al Nouf and Rumaitha/Shanayel facilities, reinforcing Mannesmann Energy’s role in supporting the development of the UAE’s energy infrastructure

Press Release

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates: Mannesmann Energy, an Abu Dhabi-based Emirati engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contractor and technology integrator, has signed an agreement with ADNOC Onshore to execute Phase II of the North East Bab (NEB) Facilities Upgrade Project. The project aims to enhance the reliability, operational efficiency and capacity of existing oil production facilities at Al Nouf and Rumaitha/Shanayel, supporting ADNOC’s long-term production objectives.

The agreement was signed by Eng. Anas Aljuaidi, Chief Executive Officer of Mannesmann Energy, and Huda Al Hanaee, Chief Financial Officer of ADNOC Onshore, during ADIPEC 2026. The scope includes engineering, procurement and construction works to upgrade existing facilities while maintaining ongoing operations.

Building on its established track record in executing brownfield projects for ADNOC Group companies, Mannesmann Energy continues to strengthen its role in supporting the modernisation of the UAE’s energy infrastructure.

Eng. Anas Aljuaidi, Chief Executive Officer of Mannesmann Energy, said: “The continued development of the UAE’s energy infrastructure requires investment not only in new projects but also in maximising the efficiency and performance of existing assets. Brownfield projects play a key role in supporting these priorities, enabling operators to optimise their facilities and meet evolving production requirements. We are proud to contribute to these efforts through our engineering and project execution capabilities.”

He added: “As an Emirati company, we are proud to contribute to the UAE’s energy ambitions by delivering projects that combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of local industry requirements. We remain committed to strengthening national engineering capabilities and providing efficient engineering solutions that support the long-term growth and competitiveness of the country’s energy sector.”

Dr. Ahmed Mohamed Alebri, CEO of ADNOC Onshore, said: "Our existing assets are the foundation of our growth, and we are investing to ensure they deliver their full potential for decades to come. Phase II of the NEB Facilities Upgrade Project is a strategic step towards a more resilient, efficient and future-ready operation, supporting ADNOC's long-term production objectives. Our partnership with Mannesmann Energy shows how national expertise is powering the next chapter of the UAE's energy leadership, while building local industrial capability and creating lasting value through ADNOC's In-Country Value programme."

About Mannesmann Energy

Mannesmann Energy is a fully independent, 100% Emirati-owned EPC contractor and technology integrator headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Emirati-owned since 2016, the company builds on a German engineering legacy and serves ADNOC and other energy-sector clients across the UAE, the Middle East and Africa.

Mannesmann Energy operates across three capabilities: EPC and technology integration, trading, and after-sales maintenance. Its business areas cover oil and gas, sustainability and infrastructure, supported by more than 20 international technology partners. 

For more information, visit www.mannesmann-energy.ae.

About ADNOC 

ADNOC is a leading diversified energy and petrochemicals group wholly owned by the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. ADNOC's objective is to maximize the value of the Emirate's vast hydrocarbon reserves through responsible and sustainable exploration, production and downstream activities to support the United Arab Emirates' economic growth and diversification. To find out more, visit: www.adnoc.ae.
